description.value: Squamish Liquor Store on Cleveland Avenue claims the largest selection of craft beer and gluten-free beer options in the Sea to Sky Corridor. The store carries BC boutique wines not available at government liquor stores, along with a broad range of artisan and organic beers, ciders, coolers, and spirits. Cyclists resupplying in Squamish can also order delivery through the Dine Easy app if heading back to accommodation.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms an active retail liquor store at 38241 Cleveland Ave, Squamish. The site lists phone (604-898-8980) and email not present in OSM, and the postal code on the website (V8B 0B4) differs from OSM (V8B 0S8). No bike parking, water refill, or washroom information appears anywhere on the site; the only WWC-relevant amenity detail is an explicit mention of gluten-free beer as a product category.
concerns: Postal code mismatch: OSM has V8B 0S8, website shows V8B 0B4. Address on file updated to website value; OSM should be corrected.
OSM record has no phone number; phone 604-898-8980 sourced from website only — cannot confirm against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, operating retail liquor store that touring cyclists might use for resupply, but none of the three required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from any evidence source.
